title: CharacterState
description: Current dynamic state for a character — what they know, feel, and carry into the next scene. Separate from static dossier (voice, backstory, design).

character_id.description: Must match the character_id in story-state.chars

current_state_revision.description: Monotonically increasing — incremented each time this file is updated

knowledge.description: What this character knows at this point in the story

knows_about.description: List of event_ids, plot_arcs, or facts the character knows

does_not_know.description: Facts/events the character is unaware of — critical for POV integrity

misconceptions.description: Beliefs the character holds that are not true

uncertain_about.description: Things the character suspects but is not sure about

emotional_state.description: The character's current emotional condition — for scene-level psychological realism

pressure_level.description: How loaded the character's pressure system is

recent_trigger.description: What just happened to push them to this state (event_id or description)

suppressed_feelings.description: Feelings the character is actively hiding

physical_tells.description: Bodily manifestations of internal state, per character voice rules

carried_pressure.description: The specific pressure this character is carrying into the next scene — the 'load' they bring

last_seen_chapter.description: chapter_id where this character was last active

last_updated_by.description: Which skill or agent last updated this state

source_lineage_note.description: How was this state derived? From which scenes, evidence, or inference?
